nodes.title: Edit instruction (reroll = variety)

widgets_values:
QWEN-EDIT DATASET TOOL ('aria') -- self-contained: it MAKES the hero, then re-poses it.
STAGE 1 (left): reroll 'Hero Seed' and watch HERO preview until you like the face (rendered
from this character's id tags in YOUR checkpoint). Then leave Hero Seed fixed on that value.
STAGE 2: leave 'Edit instruction' seed control = randomize; set batch count ~40 + Queue once
  -> output/dataset/aria/. Each frame = that hero in a new framing/angle/pose/expression/
  background/lighting, same identity + art style. (mode 'populate': the bottom box shows the
  resolved prompt and re-rolls each queue; it also still expands headless via the backend.)
Then curate the best 25-40 and run: tools/lora_train/train_lora.ps1 -Char aria.
Wildcards (__angle__/__pose__/__expression__/__framing__/__background__/__lighting__) live in
  ComfyUI-Impact-Pack/wildcards/. Too slow / OOM? re-run install_qwen_edit.ps1 -Quant Q4_K_M.
Poses too similar? __pose__/__angle__ lead the instruction on purpose -- raise the multiple-angles
  LoRA toward 1.0, or drop a scene axis. Identity drifting? lower the multiple-angles LoRA.
STAGE 3: each saved frame is face+hand detailed in YOUR checkpoint (cleaner, on-model faces).
  Set QE_STAGE3_POLISH=False in il_graphs/graphs.py to save the raw Qwen edit instead (faster).
